name: reposcout
title: RepoScout
description: Instantly find and open every Git repository on your Mac.
author: gmcmanus

commands.name: search-repositories
commands.title: Search Repositories
commands.subtitle: RepoScout
commands.description: Fuzzy search every Git repository on your Mac and open it in your editor, Finder, or terminal.

commands.name: refresh-index
commands.title: Refresh Repository Index
commands.subtitle: RepoScout
commands.description: Rediscover Git repositories in the background and refresh cached metadata.

preferences.name: searchRoots
preferences.title: Search Roots
preferences.description: Comma- or newline-separated folders to scan for Git repositories (e.g. ~/code, ~/work). Supports ~ for your home directory. RepoScout only searches these folders — leave empty and it will ask you to pick some rather than scanning your whole Mac.

preferences.name: maxDepth
preferences.title: Maximum Scan Depth
preferences.description: How many directory levels below each search root to descend. Higher values scan more but take longer.

preferences.name: ignoredDirectories
preferences.title: Ignored Directory Names
preferences.description: Comma-separated directory names to skip entirely while scanning.

preferences.name: followSymlinks
preferences.title: Follow Symlinks
preferences.label: Descend into symlinked directories while scanning
preferences.description: Disabled by default to avoid cycles and scanning external/duplicate trees.

preferences.name: includeBareRepos
preferences.title: Bare Repositories
preferences.label: Include bare Git repositories
preferences.description: Detect and index bare repositories (directories that are themselves a Git database).

preferences.name: primaryEditor
preferences.title: Primary Editor
preferences.description: Editor used by the default 'Open' action.

preferences.name: terminalApp
preferences.title: Terminal
preferences.description: Terminal application used by the 'Open in Terminal' action.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
